recipes.name: VODKA PASTA
ingredients: 1 tbsp kosher salt + more to taste
1 oz parmesan cheese, grated + more to garnish
1 tbsp kosher salt + more to taste
1/2 oz parmesan cheese, grated + more to garnish
To taste freshly ground black pepper
To garnish: chopped basil or parsley
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and season with salt. Add the dried pasta and cook until the pasta is about 1 minute shy of al dente. - 1 tbsp kosher salt + more to taste - 8 oz dried pasta
While the pasta is cooking, add the oil to a large high-walled skillet over medium heat. - 2 tbsp neutral oil
Add the onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes. - ½ yellow onion finely diced

Add the garlic, tomato paste, and red pepper flakes to the skillet and stir to combine. Continue cooking until the tomato paste deepens in color, about 2 minutes. - 2 garlic cloves minced or crushed - ⅜ cup tomato paste - ½ tsp crushed red pepper

Stir in the vodka and heavy cream. Transfer the par-cooked pasta to the sauce. Add reserved pasta cooking water, ¼ cup at a time, as necessary until the sauce is glossy and coating the pasta. - 30 vodka - 90 heavy cream - reserved pasta water
Turn off the heat and stir in the parmesan cheese. Season the pasta to taste with salt and pepper. - 1 oz parmesan cheese grated + more to garnish - salt & pepper to taste
Serve and garnish with more parmesan cheese. - 1 oz parmesan cheese grated + more to garnish
In a large high-walled skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Add the pancetta and cook until the fat has rendered out and the meat is crispy, 3-5 minutes. - ¼ cup neutral oil - 4 oz pancetta diced
Using a slotted spoon, remove the crispy pancetta and set aside on a paper towel-lined plate or bowl. Reserve about ¼ cup of the rendered fat in the skillet.
Add the onion to the skillet and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes. - ½ yellow onion finely diced

Add the garlic, Calabrian chilis, and tomato paste to the skillet and cook for 30 seconds or until the garlic is fragrant. - 2 garlic cloves crushed - 2 tsp crushed Calabrian chili peppers - 3 tbsp sundried tomato paste

Add the tomato puree to the skillet and stir to combine. Once the mixture is bubbling, turn the heat to medium low and continue to cook for 30-45 minutes or until the mixture is reduced and thickened to the consistency of tomato paste. - 8 oz tomato puree

Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a boil and season with salt. Add the dried pasta and cook until the pasta is about 1 minute shy of al dente. - 1 tbsp kosher salt + more to taste - 8 oz dried mezzi rigatoni

Stir in the vodka and heavy cream. Transfer the par-cooked pasta to the sauce. Add reserved pasta cooking water, ¼ cup at a time, as necessary until the sauce is glossy and coating the pasta - 30 vodka - 90 heavy cream - reserved pasta water

Turn off the heat and stir in the parmesan and pecorino cheese. Season the pasta to taste with salt and pepper. - ½ oz pecorino Romano cheese grated - ½ oz parmesan cheese grated + more to garnish - To taste freshly ground black pepper
Serve and garnish with the reserved crispy pancetta, more cheese, and chopped herbs of choice. - To garnish: chopped basil or parsley
